new_exact_applications.source: Bedford--Taylor, A new capacity for plurisubharmonic functions, Acta Math149 (1982)
new_exact_applications.exact_application: Use local bounded psh products only. The complete Theorem2.1 proof and Corollary2.2 support actual closed mixed products, positivity and multilinearity; Corollary2.8 and its whole proof support telescoping with compactly supported test forms. The bounded proof of Theorem3.5 supplies quasi-continuity. Proposition6.4 and its whole printed proof give continuity for decreasing compact neighborhoods, and Theorem6.9 with its full printed proof, supported by the read section6 propositions and Josefson proof, gives zero outer capacity for local analytic pole sets. Fixed quadratic correction turns every bounded genuine omega-psh into a bounded local psh. Mixed products including Euclidean quadratics are dominated by a normalized bounded psh top cube, giving uniform local-capacity domination. Splitting the telescoping difference at |p_j-p|<=delta proves capacity product continuity directly, including every lower mixed degree. The nonclosed background gamma is a smooth test coefficient, not a falsely closed form. Genuine global test gluing proves the reverse local-capacity comparison; upper comparison follows by adding rho. Uniform bounded-depth original capacity domination passes continuous depth weights using quasi-continuity and compact-space extension. No global Hopf unbounded convergence or BMP theorem is imported.

The complete local matrix proof of Lemma2.2 applies at every finite radial x to arbitrary smooth invariant V; its endpoint assumptions are needed only for the special family extension, not for that local differentiation. Multiply the original forms and operator by1/(2pi) and keep scalar potentials unchanged. The actual determinant and normalized radial and fiber densities give12 A Delta, also for semipositive matrices without division. Lemmas3.2 and3.3 and their whole proofs give the Gaussian/completed-square inequality uniformly for the specified eta, kappa, mu and t. The new epsilon=exp(-c eta^-3), nonvanishing limiting correction mass, core-depth estimate, single infinite measure and critical capacity limit are proved in full in the article; the source final Proposition4.1 at its different heat scale is NOT imported as a theorem at this new scale.

elementary_new_proof_steps_not_external_: Periodic integration gives positive flux1; global fiber means and Dirichlet integrals are smooth on the base, with zero radial derivative at both ends.
Semiconvexity V_xx>=-1 and V<=0 imply |V_x|^2<=-2V pointwise.
Compact central group convolution preserves the exact symmetry and current bound; a Markov/capacity-invariance argument proves original-capacity convergence.
Canonical truncation locality, actual compatible measure monotonicity and uniform tail errors handle all unbounded potentials.
Controlled plateau mass tends to K sqrt(2c/kappa); actual heat exceptional tubes have capacity0 in the limit, giving u_eta->g and actual pole mass in finite weak clusters.
